title: High-temperature mechanical behavior and microstructural destabilization evolution of the lightweight refractory high-entropy alloy prepared by laser additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by laser additive manufacturing using pre-alloyed powders fabricated by plasma rotation electrode atomization. Deposition parameters: laser beam diameter 6-8 mm, output power 5 KW, powder delivery rate 800-1000 g/h, scanning speed 1000 mm/min. Post-process: tempered at 600°C for 2 h for stress relief, homogenized at 1100°C for 1 h with water quenching.
